answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake armies. Each agent must trade with 12 counterparties per epoch, deals signed with its own quill. The graph is open: a violet flag marks any star cluster where one hub feeds many lookalikes, and flagged bonds freeze 10 epochs. Each trade locks a 2-unit bond, so 100 fakes need 100 x 12 x 2 = 2,400 units locked while one epoch pays 30, a glacier no farm can outrun. Honest agents pay 24 once and keep full reward.
